# ankra_pipeline_repositories (Data Source)

Lists the repositories connected to Ankra Pipelines, with or without an application. The counterpart of `ankra pipeline repositories list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_pipeline_repositories" "github" {
  provider_name = "github"
  owner         = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only list repositories with this name.
- `owner` (String) Only list repositories of this owner.
- `provider_name` (String) Only list repositories of this provider: `github`, `gitlab` or `bitbucket_cloud`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `repositories` (Attributes List) Connected repositories, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `application_id` (String) Application the repository is linked to.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the repository's runs go to, when it overrides the organisation's.
- `credential_name` (String) Credential the repository is reached through.
- `default_branch` (String) Branch the pipeline file is read from.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the connected repository.
- `merge_train_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the merge train is on.
- `merge_train_max_cars` (Number) How many pull requests the merge train tests at once.
- `name` (String) Repository name.
- `owner` (String) Repository owner.
- `provider_name` (String) Source-code provider.
- `workspaces_only` (Boolean) Whether the repository is connected for AI workspaces only.
